audience: dispatchers and delivery teams that run routes and deliveries with Onfleet

useCases.title: Check the status of today's deliveries
useCases.text: List the tasks created or completed in a time range, page by page. Get one task by its short ID to read its state and completion details.

useCases.title: Review route plans and the delivery manifest
useCases.text: List the route plans, optionally for one worker. Generate the compliance delivery manifest for one worker's route at one hub.

useCases.title: Add a delivery for a new address
useCases.text: Create a destination from an address, then create a delivery task for it. Recipients may get SMS messages unless you skip SMS.

useCases.title: Cancel orders a customer stopped
useCases.text: Get an order by its short ID to check it. Cancel the order before it completes, because completed orders cannot be cancelled.

useCases.title: Add a driver and update a webhook
useCases.text: Create a worker that belongs to one or more teams. Replace a webhook's receiving URL, trigger and options.
